Container.Name: instascrap
Container.Overview:
Follow public Instagram accounts as RSS feeds, without opening Instagram. instascrap visits the profiles a few times a day with a real Chrome signed in to an Instagram account, keeps every post and its media, and serves one feed per account on port 8080 (put your reverse proxy in front of it).
Scraping breaks Instagram's terms of use and the account used can be restricted or banned: use a dedicated account, never your personal one.
First start: open http://[your-server-ip]:6080/vnc.html, enter VNC_PASSWORD and sign in to Instagram. See the README.

Config.Name: Instagram accounts
Config.Description: Usernames to follow, comma-separated (e.g. nasagoddard,map_of_europe). A leading @ is accepted.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Base URL your feed reader uses to reach port 8080, e.g. https://feeds.example.com or http://192.168.1.10:8080. Changing it later means re-subscribing.

Config.Name: Login screen password
Config.Description: Protects the noVNC login screen on port 6080. Only the first 8 characters count.

Config.Name: Run times
Config.Description: Comma-separated HH:MM times, in the server's time zone. Each run starts up to JITTER_MINUTES later.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Archive, Instagram session and published feeds.

Config.Name: Feeds port
Config.Description: Feeds, media and the index page. Point your reverse proxy here.

Config.Name: Login screen port
Config.Description: noVNC, open only while a login is needed. LAN only: never expose it through a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Accounts per run
Config.Description: Profiles visited per run. Higher means fresher feeds and a more robot-like session.

Config.Name: Items per feed
Config.Description: Maximum posts per feed. The archive keeps everything.

Config.Name: Minimum pause (s)
Config.Description: Shortest random pause between two profiles.

Config.Name: Maximum pause (s)
Config.Description: Longest random pause between two profiles.

Config.Name: Run time jitter (min)
Config.Description: Each run starts at a random time up to this many minutes after its scheduled time.

Config.Name: Feed secret
Config.Description: Secret path segment in every feed URL. Leave empty to generate one; set 16 hex characters to keep existing URLs.

Config.Name: Discord webhook
Config.Description: Alerts (login needed, throttling, broken capture). Empty: alerts only go to the container log.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Owner of the files written to /data.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group of the files written to /data.
